body: A JetBlue Airbus A321neo struck its tail on the runway during a late-night go-around at Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) on November 22. Operating as flight B6-1187 from Boston, the aircraft, registration N2193J, was attempting to land on runway 25L at 11:44 p.m. local time when the crew initiated the go-around. As the jet pitched up to climb away, the underside of its rear fuselage scraped the runway, sending sparks flying on a live broadcast from Airline Videos. The crew climbed out safely, repositioned for a second approach to the same runway and landed without further incident at 12:01 a.m., about 16 minutes later.

The aircraft is a two-year-old Airbus A321-271NX named "StateMint Piece," delivered to JetBlue in December 2024. The Federal Aviation Administration logged a preliminary incident report noting the go-around tail strike, while the National Transportation Safety Board has not yet listed a formal investigation while the extent of the physical damage is assessed. The jet's scheduled return flight to New York-JFK, B6524, at 2:30 p.m. on November 24 was canceled, and the aircraft was still on the ground in Los Angeles about 34 hours after landing for inspection.

The incident is the third recent tail strike involving a JetBlue aircraft. In February 2026, another A321neo, N2188J, struck its tail on runway 28L at San Francisco International Airport (SFO); the NTSB's final report said the jet bounced on touchdown before the first officer pulled the sidestick fully aft while applying go-around power, causing substantial damage to the lower fuselage. In 2022, an Airbus A320, N760JB, struck its tail on departure from Hayden, Colorado, after rotating early. No injuries were reported in any of the three events.
en.summary: JetBlue flight B6-1187 struck its tail on runway 25L at Los Angeles International Airport during a late-night go-around on November 22. The crew landed safely about 16 minutes later and no one was injured; the A321neo remains grounded at LAX for inspection.
en.title: JetBlue A321neo strikes tail during go-around at Los Angeles airport

facts.claim: JetBlue flight B6-1187, an Airbus A321-271NX registered N2193J flying from Boston to Los Angeles, was landing on runway 25L at 11:44 p.m. local time on November 22 when the crew initiated a go-around and the aircraft's tail contacted the runway surface.

The crew climbed out safely, repositioned for a second approach to runway 25L and landed without further incident at 12:01 a.m., about 16 minutes later, with sparks from the tail strike visible on a live broadcast from Airline Videos.
The FAA logged a preliminary incident report noting the go-around tail strike, while the NTSB has not yet listed a formal investigation while the extent of the physical damage is assessed.

The aircraft is a two-year-old Airbus A321-271NX named 'StateMint Piece,' delivered to JetBlue in December 2024, and its scheduled return flight B6524 to New York-JFK at 2:30 p.m. on November 24 was canceled.
The aircraft was still on the ground in Los Angeles about 34 hours after landing.

In February 2026, another JetBlue A321neo, N2188J, struck its tail on runway 28L at San Francisco International Airport; the NTSB's final report said the jet bounced on touchdown before the first officer pulled the sidestick fully aft while applying go-around power, causing substantial damage to the lower fuselage.
No injuries were reported in the November 22 tail strike or in the two earlier recent JetBlue tail strikes.

body: 捷藍航空一架空中巴士A321neo客機11月22日深夜在洛杉磯國際機場（LAX）重飛時尾部觸地。該機執行B6-1187航班由波士頓飛往洛杉磯，當地時間23時44分在25L跑道進場時機組決定重飛，機身尾部下側在爬升過程中擦觸跑道，Airline Videos直播畫面可見火花飛濺。機組隨後爬升脫離，重新進場，約16分鐘後、即翌日0時01分安全落地，未再發生異常。

涉事飛機為機齡約2年的A321-271NX，註冊編號N2193J，2024年12月交付，機身命名為StateMint Piece。美國聯邦航空總署已就事件記錄初步報告，指出該機在重飛過程中發生尾部觸地；國家運輸安全委員會尚未就此事件列出正式調查，仍在評估損傷程度。該機原定11月24日下午2時30分飛往紐約甘迺迪機場（JFK）的B6524航班已經取消，截至11月24日，該機在著陸約34小時後仍停放在洛杉磯接受檢查。
這是捷藍航空近年第三起尾部觸地事件。2026年2月，另一架A321neo在舊金山國際機場著陸時尾部觸地，國家運輸安全委員會最終報告指出，該機在著陸彈跳後副駕駛將側桿拉到底並加油門重飛，造成機身下部重大損傷。2022年，一架A320在科羅拉多州海登起飛時也曾因提前拉升而尾部觸地。3起事件均無人受傷。
zh.summary: 捷藍航空B6-1187航班11月22日深夜在洛杉磯機場25L跑道重飛時尾部觸地，機組隨後安全落地，無人受傷；涉事A321neo仍停放在洛杉磯接受檢查。
